name: Burning Rage raises Sunder and Immolation Aura damage by 20% and lowers their cost by 20% (#3162)
contract: Burning Rage 707907 increases the damage and reduces the cost of Sunder and Immolation Aura by 20% (EffectBasePoints 19/-21, DieSides 1, so SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves 20/-20). Its SPELLMOD_DAMAGE effect (mask dword2 bits 9 and 31, i.e. flattened bits 73 and 95) correctly matches both Immolation (800208, the triggered spell that actually deals Immolation Aura's periodic damage) and Sunder's Explosion tick (712399); damage modifiers are authored against the damage-dealing spells, not the castables. Its SPELLMOD_COST effect (mask dword0 bit19 + dword2 bit11, i.e. flattened bits 19 and 75) matches the castables: Sunder's cast (705121) and Immolation Aura's cast (800207). There is no class-mask gap; all three assertions below hold natively.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
